search_boundary: Targeted public search for named delivered, commissioned, grid-connected or operating sodium-ion stationary BESS; vehicle and starter-battery claims excluded.

sources_checked.finding: Manufacturer/operator-side record names a 500 kWh sodium-ion system at Cleantech Park Arnhem and reports it live under real grid conditions.
Named host-site record corroborates an operational 500 kWh installation supplying energy under real conditions, while attributing performance claims to the manufacturer.
Company interim report states commercialization of 100 MWh-scale sodium-ion storage projects but does not name a qualifying site in the reviewed passage.

gate_reason: A named operational-site candidate would materially change the accepted public state and requires human review before projection.
